A Tribe Called Judah.title: A Tribe Called Judah
A Tribe Called Judah.overview: With the help of their mother, the Judah boys plan to rob a small mall. But when they arrive, they're met by real armed robbers.

The Black Book.title: Kraken. The Black Book of Hours
The Black Book.overview: Unai López de Ayala must immerse himself in the world of art collecting and forgery in order to find the legendary Black Book of Hours and save his mother, whom he had long believed to be dead

King of Boys.title: King of Boys
King of Boys.overview: The story of Alhaja Eniola Salami, a businesswoman and philanthropist with a checkered past and a promising political future. As her political ambitions see her outgrowing the underworld connections responsible for her considerable wealth, she's drawn into a power struggle that threatens everything she holds dear.

Anikulapo.title: Aníkúlápó
Anikulapo.overview: After an affair with a queen leads to his demise, an eager traveler encounters a mystical bird with the power to give him another life.

Jagun Jagun.title: Jagun Jagun
Jagun Jagun.overview: A young man determined to become a powerful warrior joins an elite army, encountering the wrath of a maniacal warlord and the love of a fierce woman.

The Wedding Party.title: The Wedding Party
The Wedding Party.overview: A lavish wedding escalates into pure Lagosian chaos, in this wild romcom produced by media mogul Mo Abudu.

Living in Bondage.title: Living in Bondage
Living in Bondage.overview: The film tells the story of a man who joins a secret cult, kills his wife in a ritual sacrifice, gains enormous wealth as a reward, and is afterwards haunted by the dead wife's ghost.

Osuofia in London.title: Osuofia in London
Osuofia in London.overview: Osuofia (Nkem Owoh), a bamboozled villager from Nigeria, travels to London, England to receive his share of an inheritance left for him by a deceased relative.

Saworoide.title: Saworoide
Saworoide.overview: When a usurper, Lapita, seizes the throne of Jogbo the scene is set for a film about the power struggles and corruption of a mythical African state tied up to the rituals of kingship – principally the beating of the Saworoide (or brass bell) drum. A homespun political parable emerges drawing interest by converting the typically unstable African political stereotypes into a fable complete with songs and a Greek Chorus that reflect upon the plot.

Brotherhood.title: Brotherhood
Brotherhood.overview: Only the love between brothers can heal a deep pain.

Lionheart.title: Lionheart
Lionheart.overview: Lyon Gaultier is a deserter in the Foreign Legion arriving in the USA entirely hard up. He finds his brother between life and death and his sister-in-law without the money needed to heal her husband and to maintain her child. To earn the money needed, Gaultier decides to take part in some very dangerous clandestine fights.

October 1.title: One October
October 1.overview: Reporter Clay Pigeon interviews New Yorkers in October, 2008.

Battle on Buka Street.title: Battle on Buka Street
Battle on Buka Street.overview: After a lifetime of rivalry, two women find themselves at loggerheads once again when they set up food businesses on the same street.

Elesin Oba.title: Elesin Oba: The King's Horseman
Elesin Oba.overview: Inspired by true life events, in the Oyo Empire in the 1940's, Elesin Oba, the king's chief horseman, succumbs to the lure of beauty and sexual desire on the very evening he is set to die in order to fulfil his lifelong debt of ritual suicide to accompany the dead Alaafin to the realm of the ancestors, he derails from a very important generational and spiritual transaction. This sets in motion a series of catastrophic consequences, in a spell-binding film of emotions, humour, and tragic role reversals that puts ancient beliefs and customs on trial in an ever increasingly post-modern and Western world.

Aki na Ukwa.title: Aki Na Ukwa
Aki na Ukwa.overview: Two young troublesome brothers cause disruption in home life, terrorise the people in their village and wreak havoc at school.

Blood Sisters.title: Blood Sisters
Blood Sisters.overview: Seven girls must spend the night in an old house, which once was a brothel, as part of an initiation.

Domitilla.title: Domitilla
Domitilla.overview: Four prostitutes who find themselves at a crossroad must join forces in this tale of survival.

Up North.title: Up North
Up North.overview: A young rebellious heir from a wealthy family is sent away to National Service in Northern Nigeria. Things don't quite go according to plan as the spoiled heir begins to find himself.

Ayinla.title: Ayinla
Ayinla.overview: Set against the backdrop of a beautiful range of hills and valleys in the southwestern Nigerian countryside, AYINLA is inspired by the life and times of Ayinla Omowura, a popular Yoruba musician in rural Nigeria.

Citation.title: Citation
Citation.overview: A bright student in Nigeria takes on the academic establishment when she reports a popular professor who tried to rape her. Based on real events.
